text: Hi, I'm arranging the seating for the family reunion so nobody has to sit alone. Table1 is for the adults and Table2 is for the cousins. Kids should sit near Table2, so put them there. Grandma wants to be at the top, so move her above Table1. Make Grandma purple, that's her favourite colour. Is Kids near Table2? Connect Grandma to Table1 and Table1 to Table2 so we can see the order. Which shape is the bottommost? Duplicate Table1 once because we need a third table. Rename Table2 to Cousins. Show me all the purple shapes. Undo the last rename if Cousins sounds wrong. Thanks, the caterer needs the final layout on Friday.

Setting up a volleyball court diagram for the beach club. Team1 sits left of the Net and Team2 sits right of the Net. Ball should be above Net. Make Ball yellow. Connect Team1 to Net and Net to Team2. Is Team1 left of Net? What is the degree of Net?

Quick sketch of how the bike parts connect for the repair manual. Chain is a small gray square. Wheel is a huge gray circle. Connect Frame to Wheel and Frame to Chain. Is there any triangle? Show me all the squares. Duplicate Brake once.

Our classroom poster needs a rule for the stars. From now on every star is green. Make Rule1 a star. What rules are set right now? Board should be at the top. Forget the rule about stars, the teacher changed it.
Trail connects Trailhead to Camp, and Camp to Peak. Make the Peak white. Is Peak reachable from Trailhead? Put Trailhead at the bottom left. Describe the route for the hikers.
Make Rain blue. Sun is huge.

Our orchestra seating chart is going to the printer this week, so I want it neat. Conductor sits at the top center of the stage. Violin, Cello and Piano should line up in a column, so distribute them vertically. Drums go at the back, so move Drums below Piano. Make Conductor white so it stands out. Connect Conductor to Violin, Cello and Piano so the cues are clear. Is Drums directly linked to Conductor? Which shape is the topmost? Describe the stage for the program notes. Rename Cello to Viola, because the second section is violas. Count the shapes on the stage. Show me all the white shapes. Undo the last distribute if the spacing is off. Thanks, the concert is in three weeks.

Mapping the bike share stations for the city council. Connect the stations one after another, in order. Is there a path from Station1 to Station3? Make Station2 orange. Which shape is the rightmost? Label Station1 as Depot. Move Station3 right of Station2.
Nucleus sits at the center, and Membrane surrounds it. Make Mitochondria green. Is there any red shape? Connect Membrane to Nucleus and Membrane to Mitochondria. Rename Mitochondria to Mito.
Making the pizza order diagram for the kitchen staff. Dough goes into the Oven, then put Cheese and Sauce on top of the Oven. Make Oven red. Which shape has the fewest connections? Undo that.
Swap Rose and Tulip, the colors got mixed up in the sketch. Make Daisy white. How many flowers are there?

We're sketching the floor plan of our small hotel for the owner's approval. Lobby is at the bottom center, and everyone walks in from there. Room1 and Room2 sit on the left, so move them left of Stairs. Stairs go up from the Lobby, so connect Lobby to Stairs. Elevator should be right of Stairs. Exit is the back door, make it red. Is Room2 near Lobby? Which shape is the leftmost? Connect Stairs to Room1 and Stairs to Room2. Describe the floor for the fire safety sheet. Duplicate Room1 twice, we have more rooms upstairs. Rename Exit to BackDoor. Count the arrows in the plan. Undo the last duplicate if we have too many rooms. Thanks, the inspector visits next week.
Espresso is a small brown circle. Latte should be right of Espresso. Mocha connects to Latte with an arrow. Is there a cycle?

Burner sits under the Flask, so move it below Flask. Connect Burner to Flask and Flask to Tube. Make Tube teal. Is Stand reachable from Burner? Align Flask and Tube on the vertical axis. Describe the setup for the lab report.
Make Dot tiny.
Arrange the singers in a circle for the warm-up. Alto should be left of Soprano. Make Bass brown. Which shape is the bottommost? Undo the last arrange.
Frog eats the Fly, so connect Frog to Fly. Fish feeds the Heron, connect Fish to Heron. Is Heron connected to Frog? Make Heron gray. Which shape has the most connections? Rename Fly to Mosquito.

Script goes to Scene1, Scene1 goes to Scene2, and Scene2 goes to Edit. Is there a path from Script to Edit? Make Edit gold. Put Script at the top left. Show me the yellow shapes. Duplicate Scene2 twice.
Make the Boss a huge red star. Connect Start to Chest and Chest to Boss with a dashed line. Is there a cycle? Move Chest right of Start. Count the shapes.

The patient checks in at Reception, then moves to Exam. Connect Reception to Exam and Exam to Pharmacy. Make Pharmacy green. Which shape is the closest to Reception? Describe the flow for the clinic staff.
Winger is a small blue triangle. Striker stands in front of the Keeper, so move Striker above Keeper. Keeper should be at the bottom center. Is there any star? Undo the last move.

We are planning the layout of the polling station for the local election, and I need it clear. Booth1, Booth2 and Booth3 should line up in a row near the Door. Table is in the middle of the room, so put it at the center. Connect Door to Booth1 and Door to Booth2 so voters go in one way. Make Door green and make Table gray. Is Booth3 near Door? Which shape is the farthest from Door? Duplicate Booth1 once because we need a fourth booth. Show me all the green shapes. Describe the room for the election officers. Rename Table to Desk. Count the arrows. Undo the last connection if the flow looks wrong. Thanks, the polling station opens next spring.
Host and Guest sit across from each other in the studio. Connect Host to Board and Guest to Board. Make Board yellow. What is linked to Board?

Aisle1 and Aisle2 run side by side, so align them horizontally. Checkout is at the bottom. Connect Aisle1 to Checkout and Aisle2 to Checkout. Make Checkout orange. Is Aisle2 reachable from Aisle1? Rename Aisle2 to Snacks.
From now on diamonds are teal. Make Score a big blue square. Connect Question to Answer. Which shape is the smallest? Label Answer as Choice.
Desk is between Shelf1 and Shelf2, put it there. Make Shelf1 brown. Is there a path from Shelf1 to Shelf2? Duplicate Desk once.

Bride and Groom stand at the Altar. Connect Bride to Altar and Groom to Altar. Make Altar white. Is Groom directly linked to Bride? Put Groom to the right of Bride. Which shape is the farthest from Altar?

We are building the poster for the science fair and the judges like clear diagrams. Plant, Light and Water are the three inputs to the experiment. Soil sits under the Plant, so move Soil below Plant. Connect Light to Plant and Water to Plant. Make Light yellow and make Water blue. Chart should be at the top right. Is Soil reachable from Light? Which shape has the most connections? Describe the experiment for the judges. Rename Chart to Results. Duplicate Water once because we tested it twice. Count the shapes on the poster. Show me all the blue shapes. Undo the last rename if the judges want the old name. Thanks, the fair is next Thursday.
Cars enter at Entry and go to Wash, then Dry, then Exit. Make Dry blue. Is there a path from Entry to Exit? Show me the list of shapes right of Wash.
Connect Stop1 to Stop2 and Stop2 to Stop3 with a dotted line. Depot is below Stop2. Make Depot gray. Count the arrows. Which shape is the leftmost? Label Stop1 as Central.
Make House brown. Put Sun2 at the top.

Soup, Salad and Bread all go on the Plate. Connect Soup to Plate, Salad to Plate, and Bread to Plate. Make Plate white. Is Bread connected to Soup? Describe the plate for the menu. Undo the last connect.

Our space station diagram is for the school project, and I'm trying to get the layout right. Hub is in the middle, so put it at the center. Module1, Module2 and Module3 should be around the Hub, so arrange them in a circle. Dock sits at the bottom, move Dock below Hub. Connect Hub to Module1, Module2 and Module3. Make Dock gray, and make Hub gold. Is there any red shape? Which shape is the farthest from Hub? Describe the station for my teacher. Duplicate Module2 once for the spare module. Rename Module3 to Lab. Count the arrows in the station. Undo the last arrange if the circle looks wrong. Show me all the gold shapes. Thanks, the project is due Wednesday.
Gate is at the bottom. Lion is left of Zebra. Giraffe should be right of Zebra. Connect Gate to Lion and Gate to Giraffe. Make Lion orange. Which shape is the topmost?
Sign in at the Table2 and get your Badge. Connect Table2 to Badge. Make Badge small. Is Sign linked to anything? Duplicate Badge twice.

Gateway sends requests to Service, Service puts jobs on Queue, and Queue feeds Worker. Worker writes to Store. Make Queue purple. Is there a cycle? Rename Store to Database. Which shape has the most connections?
Connect TeamA to TeamB, TeamB to TeamC, and TeamC to TeamA. Is there a cycle? Make TeamB green. Which shape is the least connected? Show me the list of green shapes.
Mark1 is a tiny square. Make Mark1 red. Is Mark1 tiny?
Agenda sits above Action. Connect Agenda to Action and Action to Owner. Make Owner teal. Which shape has the fewest connections? Undo that connection.
From now on squares are gray. Piece2 is a blue square. Forget that rule, I want Piece2 to stay blue. Make Piece3 green. Is there any gray shape?
Gate1 and Gate2 both open onto the Runway. Connect Gate1 to Runway and Gate2 to Runway. Make Runway gray. Which shape is the closest to Gate1? Move Gate2 below Gate1. Describe the airport.

I'm mapping the smart home devices for the install guide, and the hub is the heart of it. Hub should be at the center. Lamp is left of Fan, and Sensor sits above Hub. Connect Hub to Lamp, Fan, and Sensor. Make Heater red so it's easy to spot. Is Sensor directly linked to Lamp? Which shape has the fewest connections? Move Heater below Hub. Describe the system for the install guide. Rename Sensor to Motion. Duplicate Lamp once for the hallway. Count the arrows. Show me all the red shapes. Undo the last move if the layout looks off. Thanks, the installer comes Saturday.
River connects Source to Sea. Make River blue. Is Sea reachable from Source? Move Sea below River. Count the shapes.
Pump pushes water into Pipe, and Pipe fills Tank. Make Tank large. Is Tank bigger than Pump? Redo that.
Sword and Shield go into the Bag. Make Potion green. Put Bag at the center. Rename Potion to Elixir. Is Sword connected to Shield?

Hallway connects Kitchen, Bedroom and Bath. Make Hallway gray. Put Bedroom above Kitchen. Is Bath near Kitchen? Which shape is the rightmost? Duplicate Bedroom once for the guest room. Describe the layout.
Arrange Mat1, Mat2 and Mat3 in a row, then distribute them horizontally. Make Mat2 purple. Show me all the purple shapes. Redo that.
Delete Mat3.
Bring Mat1 to the front. Send Mat3 to the back. Is there any blue shape?

Tutor sketch for a geometry class with my students, I want a simple example. Triangle1 is a red triangle. Square1 should be above Triangle1. Make Circle1 yellow, it's the reference shape. Connect Triangle1 to Square1 and Square1 to Circle1 with a dotted line. Is there any blue shape? Describe the figure for the homework. Show me all the triangles. Rename Circle1 to Sun, the kids asked for a sun. Duplicate Triangle1 twice. Count the shapes. Undo the last rename if the students get confused. Thanks, the homework is due tomorrow.
